claim: FdeE and FdeC catalyse steps of naringenin degradation
finding: FdeE hydroxylates naringenin to 5,7,8-trihydroxyflavanone with NADPH alone; FdeC cleaves the A ring
context: H. seropedicae SmR1, purified enzymes in vitro
confidence: high for the activities; the assay does not test any role for FdeD

claim: FdeD is the reductase of FdeE
finding: FdeE is the FMO of H. seropedicae SmR1; Pfam PF01494 (FAD_binding_3), a single-component class A flavoprotein monooxygenase reduced directly by NAD(P)H
context: H. seropedicae SmR1 enzyme used as a biocatalyst
confidence: high; class A FMOs need no external electron carrier, so the KEGG link of FdeD to the FdeE step is pathway co-membership

claim: A flavonoid hydroxylase of this family works without a Rieske partner
finding: RgF8H, a flavonoid C8-hydroxylase, requires NADPH for prosthetic group regeneration and has no ferredoxin partner
confidence: moderate; functional analogue, not an ortholog of FdeE

claim: Small Rieske proteins of 100-125 aa serve diiron monooxygenases
finding: T4moC is obligately required for electron transfer between the oxidoreductase and the diiron hydroxylase of toluene-4-monooxygenase
context: Pseudomonas mendocina KR1, reconstituted four-protein complex
confidence: high for T4moC; SmR1 encodes no diiron BMM hydroxylase, so this class has no acceptor in this genome

claim: Partner class is a functional constraint, not a fold property
finding: Of T4moC, TbuB, the Thermus Rieske protein and BphF, all except BphF complemented T4MO; T4moC belongs to a clade specialised for diiron hydroxylases
confidence: high; justifies treating FdeD's failure to match any clade as informative

claim: A small ferredoxin next to an extradiol dioxygenase reactivates it
finding: xylT deletion drops catechol 2,3-dioxygenase activity on p-toluate to 1 percent of wild type
context: Pseudomonas putida TOL plasmid meta-cleavage operon
confidence: high for the paradigm; XylT is a plant-type four-Cys ferredoxin, not Rieske-type

claim: The reactivating ferredoxin acts directly on the dioxygenase
finding: CbzT, CdoT and AtdS are [2Fe-2S] proteins; CbzT reactivates 4-methylcatechol-inactivated CbzE in vitro and cross-links to it
confidence: high for the mechanism; structural class differs from FdeD

claim: XylT-dependent reactivation generalises to oxidative inactivation
finding: XylT restores H2O2-oxidised XylE; cysteines at 41, 46, 49 and 81 define the plant-type cluster site
confidence: high; confirms FdeD's ligand set is of a different type

claim: The fold of FdeD identifies its partner class
finding: AlphaFold D8J0W8 superposes on 1FQT 1.51 A / 83 CA, 1VM9 1.34 A / 82 CA, 1RIE 1.67 A / 80 CA; spread 0.33 A
context: AlphaFold DB model_v6, mean pLDDT 94.81; Kabsch fit seeded on the four cluster ligands
confidence: direct computational result; the fold is uninformative for partner assignment

claim: FdeD belongs to a characterised Rieske partner class
finding: Inter-cysteine spacing 24 (fde homologs 24-29) against 18-21 in all 21 reviewed references; CPH triad matches diiron-BMM 3/3 vs ring-hydroxylating 0/14 (Fisher p=0.0015); best identity 23.4 percent
context: UniProt reviewed PF00355 proteins 80-170 aa with assigned partners
confidence: direct computational result; n=3 for the diiron-BMM class limits the triad inference

claim: fdeD is present wherever the rest of the fde locus is present
finding: 58 of 65 fdeE-containing genomes (89.2 percent) carry a small Rieske gene within 6 genes of fdeE, 57 of 65 (87.7 percent) within 2 genes; 8 genomes lack one
context: NCBI IPG plus region-restricted CDS retrieval around fdeE homologs
confidence: direct computational result; absences may be assembly or annotation gaps, so 89.2 percent is a lower bound

claim: The four cluster ligands are conserved in fde-locus homologs
finding: 40 of 40 collected homologs retain Cys, His, Cys, His with first triad CPH in all cases; no ligand lost
context: fdeD homologs from the neighbourhood scan
confidence: direct computational result; conservation argues the cluster is functional but not what it does

finding: The record carries EC 2.7.1.50 and GO:0004417 with evidence IEA:UniProtKB-EC, inherited from the EMBL submission; the only domain content is PF00355 / PS51296 / SSF50022
confidence: high; a 112 aa Rieske protein cannot carry a thiazole kinase domain, so this is database carry-over
